ignorePatterns:
worker-configuration.d.ts
pnpm-lock.yaml
src/generated/**
specs/google-calendar-v3.openapi.json
specs/zoom-meetings.openapi.json
.wrangler/**
dist/**

rules.rule: Every provider route authenticates the request before doing any work: POST /zoom/webhook and POST /slack/* verify the provider signature against the raw body before the body is parsed (flag any handler that reads or parses the body first); POST /google/notify has no body or signature (Google Calendar push), so it checks X-Goog-Channel-Token against GOOGLE_WATCH_TOKEN before dispatching. Do not flag the Google route for lacking a body signature.

Personal join_url values, join tokens, the Zoom host key, GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY, signed JWT assertions, access tokens and the calendar watch token never go into `log.*` or `notifyBotLog` fields. Log event names and ids only.
The `CRON_JOBS` keys in src/cron.ts and `triggers.crons` in wrangler.jsonc must match byte-for-byte, weekdays spelled (`MON`), never numeric (ADR 0005). Flag a change to one without the other.
A new non-secret entry in wrangler.jsonc `vars` needs a matching hand-typed field in src/env.ts (then `pnpm cf-types`). Secrets (`*_TOKEN`, `*_SECRET`, `*_KEY`) never go in `vars`.
